string.name: text
string.value: Fascinated, you watched as the Maple Leaf transformed into a jewel.

string.name: text
string.value: Suddenly, power filled your veins and your attacks began to have an effect. It was the blessing of a Goddess.

string.name: text
string.value: You gave it everything you had, and in the end, you vanquished the darkness.

string.name: text
string.value: The Goddess revealed she was spirit of Maple Island, who dwelled in the Maple Tree.

string.name: text
string.value: She sensed that the world was in danger, and sent her other self, Sugar, to keep watch.

string.name: text
string.value: She said the Maple Leaf had become the Seal Stone of Maple Island, formed out of your friends' desire to save the island.

string.name: text
string.value: Using its power, you restored Maple Island to its original form.

string.name: text
string.value: Then, you hugged your friends goodbye.

string.name: text
string.value: And so this story drew to a close, but others had yet to begin. More adventures awaited those with the will to search for them.
